newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann shares down after 1996 data.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann shares down after 1996 data.

text.p: Shares in German engineering and technology group Mannesmann AG dropped on Thursday in a generally falling market after reporting 1996 earnings that some dealers said were partly worse than expected.
Mannesmann shares were down seven marks, or around one percent, at 671 marks at 1037 GMT, but were slightly more stable than the DAX 30-share index, which was down 1.4 percent.
"The share is actually holding up quite well in a very weak environment," one dealer said.
However others said that Mannesmann's 1996 net profit of 600 million marks was slightly below their expectations.
The decision to hike its dividend to nine marks from eight marks also disappointed some. "There were definitely hopes for more," another trader said.
